_comment: Curriculum example — mcp-config.json (D2). Three scopes side by side, plus the error-response contract a server should honour. Only the 'project' block is a real .mcp.json shape; the others show where the same entry would live.

project_scope__.mcp.json._where: <repo>/.mcp.json — committed; every clone gets it after a one-time approval prompt
project_scope__.mcp.json._use_for: servers the whole team needs for THIS repo (test results, the app's API, the browser)

user_scope__~/.claude.json._where: ~/.claude.json (global section) — `claude mcp add --scope user …`; yours in every repo
user_scope__~/.claude.json._use_for: personal tooling and accounts: GitHub, Slack, notes; never committed

local_scope__~/.claude.json[project]._where: ~/.claude.json under this project's path — the default for `claude mcp add`; you, this repo only
local_scope__~/.claude.json[project]._use_for: experiments and servers with personal tokens for this repo

precedence: local > project > user when names collide; `--mcp-config file --strict-mcp-config` replaces all three for one run; managed settings can deny servers entirely

error_response_design._rule: A tool result is what the MODEL reads next. Make failures actionable, never silent, never a stack trace.

content.text: POST /transactions -> 500 Internal Server Error. The RWA API is running but rejected the payload; senderId 'uBmeaz5pX' exists, receiverId 'nobody' does not. Call search_users first to get a valid receiver id.
Traceback (most recent call last): File "/srv/app/db.py", line 88 …

error_response_design.in_python: raise ToolError('message') in an mcp MCPServer tool; return {'content': [...], 'is_error': True} from an Agent SDK @tool; set is_error=True on a tool_result in the raw API loop
error_response_design.protocol_level_vs_tool_level: JSON-RPC error (code -32602 invalid params, -32601 unknown method) = the CALL was malformed; isError:true inside a normal result = the call was fine but the OPERATION failed — the model can retry or change course only in the second case
